codeSystems.name: BinocularFindingVS
codeSystems.title: Binocular Finding Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Qualitative findings recorded at a gaze position: sensory responses on the red
filter plus light and Worth 4 dot tests (fusion, suppression of one eye, crossed or
uncrossed diplopia) and the position of the corneal light reflex on the Hirschberg test
(centered, or displaced nasally, temporally, superiorly or inferiorly in the eye assessed).
The binding is extensible, so other findings (e.g. tropia vs phoria on a prism cover test)
may be used when no concept here applies.

codeSystems.name: GazePositionVS
codeSystems.title: Gaze Position Value Set
codeSystems.description:
The nine diagnostic positions of gaze at which a strabismus measurement or
binocular finding is recorded: primary position, the four secondary positions (up gaze /
supraversion, down gaze / infraversion, right gaze / dextroversion, left gaze / levoversion)
and the four tertiary (oblique) positions. SNOMED CT qualifier values from the Gaze
directions hierarchy.

codeSystems.name: HorizontalDeviationDirectionVS
codeSystems.title: Horizontal Deviation Direction Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Direction of a horizontal ocular deviation at a gaze position: esodeviation,
exodeviation, or orthophoria when no horizontal deviation is present. Covers both tropias
and phorias; the magnitude is recorded separately as a positive value.

codeSystems.name: LowVisionAssessmentVS
codeSystems.title: Low Vision Assessment Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Qualitative visual acuity for patients whose vision falls below what any
chart can measure (ICD-11 blindness categories 4 through 6). All five codes are confirmed
SNOMED CT concepts, verified directly against the SNOMED CT browser. See Terminology for
the full clinical and terminology rationale. The counting-fingers concept below uses the
generic code by default; the more specific distance-based codes may be used instead when
that detail is known.

codeSystems.name: NormativeClassificationVS
codeSystems.title: Normative Classification Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Classification of an ophthalmic measurement or analysis against the device
normative (age-matched reference) database: within normal limits, borderline, or outside
normal limits. Used for the overall interpretation of OCT macula and OCT RNFL / optic nerve
head analyses, and for the per-subfield deviation category of the OCT macula profile.
Bindings are extensible, so device-specific percentile categories (e.g. p<5%, p<1%) may be
used when no concept here applies.

codeSystems.name: OphthalmicCarePlanCategoryVS
codeSystems.title: Ophthalmic Care Plan Category Value Set
codeSystems.description:
The type of ophthalmic treatment scheme. Proposed FHIR4Eyes-only codes,
open to revision if a suitable external code is identified later.

codeSystems.name: TestDistanceCategoryVS
codeSystems.title: Test Distance Category Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Categorical testing distance of a strabismus or binocular vision test: near
(about 33-40 cm) or far (about 6 m / 20 ft). The binding is extensible, so other categories
(e.g. intermediate) may be used when needed.

codeSystems.name: VerticalDeviationDirectionVS
codeSystems.title: Vertical Deviation Direction Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Direction of a vertical ocular deviation of the deviating eye at a gaze
position: hyperdeviation or hypodeviation. Covers both tropias and phorias; the magnitude is
recorded separately as a positive value.
